title: citrus × limonia var. limetta
intro: Citrus × limonia var. limetta, commonly known as sweet lime or limetta, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help manage digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of sweet lime are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of sweet lime have been shown to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-hypertensive, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
